description:
Three coupled bugs in `OctoPi.Coder.CLI.run_rpc/1`:

1. `OctoPi.Agent.subscribe(session, self(), :async)` subscribes the
   CLI main pid, but rpc_loop blocks on `IO.read(:stdio, :line)` so
   events never drain. Events silently accumulate in its mailbox
   and the spawned forwarder process receives nothing.

2. `send(event_forwarder, {:owner, self()})` is dead — forward_events
   has no matching clause. Refactor artifact.

3. `IO.puts(Jason.encode!(response))` raises if the response map
   contains a non-encodable value (pid, fun, weird binary). Crashes
   the rpc_loop and the whole session dies silently.

Fix:
- Subscribe the forwarder pid, not CLI main:
  `OctoPi.Agent.subscribe(session, event_forwarder, :async)`.
- Drop the {:owner, self()} send.
- Wrap `Jason.encode!` in try/rescue; on failure emit a generic
  `{"id": id, "error": {"message": "encoding failed"}}` so the
  client still gets a response and the loop continues.

TDD:
- E2E test: start an RPC session with FakeTransport, send a
  `{"method": "prompt", ...}` request, assert a request response
  AND event JSON lines arrive on captured stdout in order.
- Jason.encode failure test: inject an un-encodable value, assert
  the loop survives and emits an error response.
title: Fix RPC event forwarding + robust JSON encoding
